## Checklist (Definition of Done — see `docs/definition-of-done.md`)

- [ ] Scope is limited to the current checkpoint (no future-checkpoint work).
- [ ] Tests added/updated; they pass locally.
- [ ] Coverage meets the gate (≥ 80% core; 100% critical paths).
- [ ] Lint, format, and type checks pass.
- [ ] No secrets committed; **no PHI in code, tests, logs, or fixtures**.
- [ ] Observability added for new components (where applicable).
- [ ] Docs/ADRs/traceability updated (where applicable).
- [ ] AI change: eval metrics meet targets / passes the eval gate (where applicable).
